text:
elaine: Heads-up — FinReg Corp wants detailed access control proof ASAP for tomorrow's risk review. They asked specifically about: scoped service accounts, rotation cadence, session durations, SAML attribute mappings, and how we enforce MFA for SSO users. Can someone pull together quick artifacts and short answers?

samir: I can do SSO + MFA bits. short answers: we support SAML 2.0 & OIDC, MFA enforcement is driven by customer IdP in most deployments; for Hosted we require MFA for org admins by default and surface enforcement in audit logs. I’ll include screenshots of the authz page and an example assertion. :lock:

morgan: I'll draft the RBAC mapping and service-account guidance. For Dedicated/Private we provide scoped service accounts (principals) with least-privilege roles and enforce key rotation. Example: service account tokens are short-lived (default 1h) and can be constrained by route/prefix.

jordan: Quick clarifying points for the questionnaire: default interactive session timeout = 60m, API session token TTL = 15m with refresh via refresh_token flow (configurable). Breakglass flow exists for emergency ops with extra approval and extra audit logging.

elainE: @samir @morgan can we export: 1) SAML metadata URL or sample XML; 2) screenshot of the SSO enforcement toggle; 3) role mapping YAML snippet; 4) audit log query showing a successful MFA enforcement event? Need single ZIP to send.

samir: Working on the SAML sample and logs. Sample SAML attribute mapping (send in thread):

```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="uid"><AttributeValue>${user.email}</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="groups"><AttributeValue>${user.groups}</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="roles"><AttributeValue>redwood:viewer</AttributeValue></Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```

morgan: RBAC mapping snippet (for their questionnaire) — note this is a minimal example to show least privilege: 

```
roles:
  - name: app-reader
    permissions:
      - read:models
      - read:logs
  - name: deployer
    permissions:
      - create:jobs
      - update:deployments
service_accounts:
  - name: poc-sa
    scopes: ["read:models"]
    token_ttl: 3600
```

samir: For audit evidence, use this curl to pull the MFA event (requires org-admin token):

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://console.redwood/instrumentation/audit?event_type=mfa.challenge&since=72h"
```

infra-bot: audit-export created: /exports/finreg/mfa_events_1749803333.csv (presigned link expires in 24h)

jordan: Also include a short paragraph we can paste into the SIG/CAIQ answer: 
"Redwood delegates primary authentication to customers' IdPs via SAML/OIDC. MFA is enforced at the IdP and recorded in Redwood audit logs; we offer tenant-level controls to require MFA for sensitive roles and provide emergency breakglass approvals with escalated audit trails."

morgan: I'll package the RBAC YAML, SAML metadata sample (https://files.redwood/saml/finreg-sample-metadata.xml), screenshots, and the infra-bot CSV link into a ZIP and drop it to the thread within the hour.

elaine: Amazing, thank you. If we can also include a short note on how service account rotation is handled (KMS-backed, nightly rotation + immediate revoke on compromise) that would close their checklist. I’ll send to FinReg after review. :thumbsup:
